WITH scan_data AS (
  SELECT 
    site.healtheval,
    s.scancount,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 
         THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM scans s 
  LEFT JOIN sites site ON s.zoneref = site.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' 
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scan_data
  WHERE healtheval IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
mean_check AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM status_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  s.healtheval,
  s.total_scans,
  s.avg_ratio,
  s.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS deviation_from_mean
FROM status_stats s
CROSS JOIN mean_check m
WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.healtheval
